title: Autonomous Multi-Agent Bridge & Second Brain
description: Engineered a Human-in-the-Loop bridge daemon connecting autonomous AI coding harnesses with Telegram & Apple Watch push triggers, live action streaming, and a persistent FIFO task queue. title: BetterTanks — 2D Tactical Combat & Enemy AI

Engineered an orbit-based cover avoidance algorithm from Collider2D.bounds and decoupled subsystems with Object Pooling. Logged ~87.4h across 10+ Jira epics.

title: Cloud ETL Pipelines & Browser CDP Engine
description: Developed automated Python synchronization pipelines connecting Google Drive (real-time XLSX trackers), Sheets, and Gmail APIs with scheduled macOS launchd daemons.
